cohort: The study included 11,357 8- to 14-year-old children and adolescents from The Finnish Health in Teens study.
finding: Higher levels of disordered eating were independently associated with maternal pre-pregnancy BMI, maternal smoking during pregnancy, and urgent or emergency cesarean birth, while assisted reproduction was associated with lower levels.
mod_finding: Urgent or emergency cesarean birth was independently associated with higher levels of disordered eating.
